title: Betiyan to sab ko
body:
zindan e shaam mein wo qayamat ka waqt tha
saumpa gaya sakina ko jab sar hussain ka
baba ke zakhmi chehre se khoon saaf jab kiya
baalon se khaak jhaad ke beti ne ye kaha
<<DIVIDER>>
tum to kehte thay sakina
tum bin mera dil nahi lagta
phir kyun itni dayr ki aane mein tumne baba
<<DIVIDER>>
betiyan to sab ko pyari hoti hai na baba
dekho mujhko shaam ke logon ne kitna maara
<<DIVIDER>>
aap thay jab tak saath ay baba ye beti shehzadi thi
naaz uthaate thay sab mere sab ki pyari beti thi
haath chacha rakhte thay zameen par ghar mein jab mai chalti thi
mujhko sahara dene sab uth jaate thay jab girti thi
lekin ye masoom sakina jab giri naaqe se baba
mujhe sahara kyun dene koi bhi na aaya baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyare ammu chod gaye thay pani ko mai tarsi thi
bas ye mai hi jaanti hoon bazaar mein kaise chalti thi
shimr tamache maarta tha jab bhi thak kar mai rukti thi
mujhko ye bhi yaad nahi tha ke mai kab se pyasi thi
apni betiyon ko ye shaami la la kar dete thay pani
jab mai pani maangti thi khaati thi kyun durra
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
choom ke baba ka zakhmi sar beti boli ay baba
kuch din pehle qaid mein mujhse milne aayi thi ramla
mere gohar pehni thi mujhko us baat ka gham na tha
mai ye soch ke rone lagi jab dekha ramla ka chehra
zaalim ne darbar mein baba mujhe kaneezi mein jab maanga
us ke ghar mein bhi to ek beti hai kyun na socha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba aap ka qaatil mere saamne jab bhi aata tha
aap ka jis pe khoon laga tha wo khanjar lehrata tha
baandh ke mujhko rassi se rahwaar wo jab daudata tha
nok e sina se mere chacha abbas ka sar gir jaata tha
naize par us waqt ay baba aap ko maine rote dekha
zaalim ne jab raah mein baalon se mujhe khayncha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
aag lagi thi daaman mein aur haath tha zakhmi kaano par
shaam e ghariban mein jab tumko dhoonde nikli mai baahar
baba maine dekha tha apni aankhon se wo manzar
dada ko awaaz phupi zainab ne jab di ro ro kar
beti ki awaaz pe haye dada ali to milne aaye
lekin mera haal kyun tumne na aa kar poocha
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar e hussain pukara beti yaad karo na wo manzar
baba baba kehte huwe jab girti thi tum laashon par
maine hi to paas bulaya tha shehzadi ye keh kar
soja meri bacchi zakhmi seene pe tu sar rakh ke
be-sar tha beti ye baba paas tumhare kaise aata
tum ne jab awaaz de kar bola tha ay baba
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
<<DIVIDER>>
beti baba se boli ab chod ke mujhko mat jaana
kab tak hai meri qismat mein zaalim ke durre khaana
tum bhaiya sajjad se keh do mujhko yahin par dafnana
baap se baatein karte karte aakhri hichki ka aana
ay zeeshan o raza ro ro kar baba ke moo pe moo rakh kar
baali sakina ne bas ye kehte huwe dam toda
betiyan to sab ko pyari...
author: Zeeshan Abidi
